_meta.source: Extracted from starfi5h/AlchemyFactoryCalculator develop branch engine code (DB v55, gameVersion 1.0.4950, 2026-09-12), the official 1.0 patch notes (Steam announcement gid 1842846814454819, 2026-09-08) and the v0.5.4467 notes (gid 1833968530899984, 2026-06-02)

cauldron.description: Deterministic 3-input combiner. As of v0.5.4467 (June 2, 2026) the additional output-generation multiplier was REMOVED by the developer; output selection is now purely nearest-target. Items have cauldronCost (input value), cauldronTarget (output selection target), and cauldronMulti (distance weighting).

model.inputs: exactly 3 items, each contributing its cauldronCost
model.outputSelection: output = argmin over items-with-cauldronTarget of |T - cauldronTarget| * cauldronMulti; ties broken by lower item id

craftTimeAndHeat.description: Piecewise-linear interpolation over the OUTPUT item's cauldronTarget

cauldron.machineNote: Cauldron and Advanced Cauldron carry machines.heatCost = -1 in the DB: their heat draw is output-dependent (see craftTimeAndHeat). The curated Cauldron recipe rows carry that PER-BATCH heat in recipe.heatCost. The upstream "Unstable Catalyst (Gentian Mixture)" row uses a virtual input and is skipped by the validator.

advancedAthanorCatalysts.description: Added in v0.5.4467 (June 2026). Recipes carry a ChargeCost; inserting a catalyst consumes ChargeCost / catalystCharges catalyst items per batch. Since DB v50 (August 2026) the Advanced Athanor is heatCost -1 and each recipe carries its own PER-SECOND draw in recipe.heatCost: 32/s for the four commodity recipes (Coke, Steel Ingot, Copper Powder, Salt), 360/s for the gem recipes.

Unstable Catalyst.effect: replaces recipe outputs with the recipe's unstableOutputs (altered product probabilities/mix)

Resonant Catalyst.effect: replaces recipe outputs with resonantOutputs (generates all products simultaneously)

Eternal Catalyst.effect: recipe consumes no material inputs (only catalyst charges)

advancedAthanorCatalysts.stackingNote: Catalysts can combine (the calculator applies eternal -> unstable -> resonant -> fertile in that order; fertile doubles whatever output set is active).

heatAndFuel.description: Heat-using machines (slotsRequired > 0) sit on a heating device — Stone Furnace (9 slots), Blast Furnace (42), or Steam Heating Pad (9) — chosen by config.heatingDevice (src/heating.js). Fuel items carry items.heat (energy). Burned heat is multiplied by fuelMult from the Fuel Efficiency skill.
heatAndFuel.baseHeatRemoved: 1.0 (2026-09-08): "Removed the base heat cost of all heating devices." Devices no longer draw heat on their own (heatSelf = 0 in DB v55); a machine consumes heat only while it runs.
heatAndFuel.machineHeatDraw: heatPerSec = machine.heatCost * speedMult while running. Machines with heatCost -1 read the draw from recipe.heatCost: per second for the Advanced Athanor and Steam Boiler, per batch for the curated Cauldron rows.
heatAndFuel.heatPerBatch: heat per batch = heatCost * recipe.baseTime — speedMult cancels, so faster factories do not save heat per item
heatAndFuel.selfFuelLoops: Loops like Charcoal-fired Charcoal production are solvable: net fuel output = gross heat produced - heat consumed by the production chain. The starfi5h calculator exposes gold-per-power (G/P) ratios for choosing the cheapest heat source.

steam.description: Tier 6 heat-DISTRIBUTION layer: fuel -> [Steam Boiler] -> Steam (virtual liquid item 9002) -> pipes -> [Steam Heating Pad] -> heat -> heated machine on the pad. Since 1.0 the pad draws no base heat, so its only costs are the boiler fuel and any conversion loss.

steamBoiler.role: burns fuel to produce Steam; machines.heatCost -1 with the draw on the recipe
steamBoiler.upstreamRecipe: Steam Boiler (High): 3000 heat/s for 2 s -> 300 Steam (6000 heat per 300 Steam, i.e. 20 heat per Steam unit at the boiler)
steamBoiler.outputSettings: the game offers Low/Mid/High boiler settings; only High is in DB v55
steamBoiler.idleBurn: NONE (verified in-game 2026-09-14): with the steam line full and no pads drawing, fuel consumption settles at exactly 0. Boilers burn only against demand, so extra boilers cost nothing to keep and the filled pipe network acts as a buffer.

heatingPad.steamPerHeat: NOT in upstream data (the pad is modeled as a plain generator). Pre-1.0 community figures: ~60 steam/hour consumption, and a controlled test delivering ~60% of direct-burn heat. Needs an in-game measurement on 1.0.

steam.steamPipes: transport and store steam across floors with effectively unlimited throughput
steam.efficiencyVsDirect: STEAM_EFFICIENCY = 0.6 in src/config.js is the pre-1.0 community measurement (597 vs 360 product from identical charcoal). Unverified on 1.0; re-measure.
steam.modelingDecision: Modeled in the tile composer as a central utility (config.steam: enabled, mode free|cost). Central steam sets the heating device to the Steam Heating Pad and removes the fuel production trunk from the build; "cost" charges the fuel value / STEAM_EFFICIENCY. Kept because steam is the long-term heating layout; the pad consumption rate above is the open number. Boilers have no idle burn, so boiler count is sized to peak draw only.
sources: starfi5h DB v49 (2026-07-29): "Add Steam and Steam Boiler"

fertilizer.description: Crops grown in Nursery / World Tree Nursery / Miniature World Tree consume nutrients (recipe.nutrientCost). Fertilizer items carry items.nutrientValue, multiplied by fertMult from the Fertilizer Efficiency skill; plots have maxFertility. Nursery crop recipes have no baseTime: per-plot rate = min(60 * maxFertility * speedMult / nutrientCost, beltSpeed). Factory Efficiency speeds growth (verified in-game 2026-09-13: Redcurrant on Advanced Fertilizer 60 -> 75/min per plot at level 1). Belt speed and Factory speed share one curve (belt = 60 * speedMult at equal levels), so at equal levels plots per belt are invariant. The tier-2 Seed Plot is time-driven instead: 1 seed -> 120..200 herbs per plot cycle (400..2160 s), no nutrients, and NOT affected by the speed multiplier.
fertilizer.selfFertLoops: Self-sustaining fertilizer loops (crops -> fertilizer -> crops) are solvable the same way as self-fuel; the calculator exposes gold-per-nutrient-value (G/V) ratios.

logistics.beltSpeed: 60 items/min base; see skills.json logistics_efficiency for the leveling formula
logistics.conveyorRefactor: v0.5.4467 "Refactoring Conveyor System" plus 1.0 fixes to split/merge distribution and Priority Mergers; belt numbers still need in-game verification
logistics.railSystem: Wagon System shipped in 1.0 (2026-09-08): rail-based logistics with higher capacity than conveyors. Not in the upstream dataset and not modeled here; the belt-cap layer in the tile composer is conveyor-only.

economy.prices: items carry buyPrice (Purchasing Portal), sellPrice, wholesalePrice on some items; coins are items crafted at the Bank Portal. DB v55 also lists Purchasing Portal buy rows and Bank Portal coin-exchange rows as recipes; src/recipes.js filters them out (purchases are priced from buyPrice, coins interchange at face value).
economy.junePatchNote: Black Powder sellPrice AND heat were both doubled in v0.5.4467
economy.v1Note: 1.0: Linseed Oil production and consumption scaled by the same factor (50 -> 20 per Flax; consumers 200 -> 80, 300 -> 120); Obsidian byproduct Volcanic Ash -> Marble (Volcanic Ash now comes from an Enhanced Grinder recipe on Obsidian); Clockwork Bird no longer salable; sell prices raised on Crown, Luna, Sol, Pocket Watch; Brew Barrel beverages (five virtual liquid items with sellPrice); shop sales upgrade sellMult(lvl) = 1 + 0.01*lvl (not applied by this planner). Between June and 1.0 the upstream DB also fixed Obsidian inputs (Crude -> Shattered Crystal) and halved Bronze Ingot cauldronCost (293 -> 155).

throughputModel.machineOutputRate: outputsPerMin = (60 / (recipe.baseTime / speedMult)) * batchYield, where batchYield = recipe output count * alchemyMult (yield-multiplier machines only; Thermal Extractor x3 extra at full height). Seed Plot ignores speedMult.
throughputModel.machinesNeeded: targetRate / machineOutputRate, fractional machines rounded up per line segment
